checks.evidence: Inventor contribution is confirmed and R&D evidence includes prototype, experiment, log, or source hashes.
checks.risk_if_ignored: A filing without real inventive activity can be treated as abnormal and should not proceed.
checks.required_cure: Collect inventor contribution confirmation and real R&D evidence before draft generation or filing.
checks.owner: Patent Capital OS abnormal filing risk gate

checks.evidence: No random-generation, simple-replacement, or synonym-substitution marker was found in core disclosure fields.
checks.risk_if_ignored: Random computer generation, fabricated effects, or simple wording changes can make the filing abnormal.
checks.required_cure: Replace generated or wording-only material with real technical contribution evidence and inventor confirmation.
checks.owner: Patent Capital OS abnormal filing risk gate

checks.evidence: Similarity control is confirmed and provenance rows do not use prior-art/reference hashes as applicant claim support.
checks.risk_if_ignored: Copying or simply replacing prior art can create abnormal-filing and invalidity risk.
checks.required_cure: Remove copied material, rewrite claims from applicant evidence, and rerun provenance validation.
checks.owner: Patent Capital OS abnormal filing risk gate

checks.evidence: All technical effects cite evidence hashes traceable to applicant disclosure or R&D material.
checks.risk_if_ignored: Unsupported effects can be treated as fabricated technical effects.
checks.required_cure: Tie each technical effect to applicant evidence and remove unsupported performance claims.
checks.owner: Patent Capital OS abnormal filing risk gate

checks.evidence: The draft has multiple required features, known prior-art references, and element-level prior-art delta rows.
checks.risk_if_ignored: Obvious patchwork of references can be treated as low-quality abnormal filing and weak claim strategy.
checks.required_cure: Build a feature-by-feature prior-art delta and remove unsupported combinations.
checks.owner: Patent Capital OS abnormal filing risk gate

checks.evidence: No unreasonable-degradation or non-essential-narrowing marker was found.
checks.risk_if_ignored: Unreasonable degradation or non-essential narrowing can indicate a bad-faith filing pattern.
checks.required_cure: Explain the technical purpose of narrowed features or remove artificial degradation language.
checks.owner: Patent Capital OS abnormal filing risk gate

checks.evidence: No maliciously distributed batch filing or duplicate filing marker was found in the case text.
checks.risk_if_ignored: Maliciously distributed batch filings can trigger abnormal-filing handling.
checks.required_cure: Provide legitimate portfolio purpose and distinct invention evidence for each case.
checks.owner: Patent Capital OS abnormal filing risk gate

checks.evidence: Applicant, inventors, and contribution confirmation are present.
checks.risk_if_ignored: False or inconsistent inventor/applicant information can block legal gate and create abnormal-filing risk.
checks.required_cure: Confirm applicant identity, inventor list/order, and real contribution before any filing package.
checks.owner: Patent Capital OS abnormal filing risk gate
